data.content: Plan review approved. The plan covers all four acceptance clauses, uses exact tree/blob membership rather than timestamps, places active-manifest validation before scanning, uses expected-head CAS for remote atomicity, and preserves unique local paths during idempotent pruning. Tests cover stale, legacy, concurrent, conflict, interruption, and unpushed-event cases. The additive shared-contract strategy limits merge risk with knots-2af8.
